body:
`mori check` discarded errors from the Core profile reader and regenerated a Core/1-only diagnostic. It now preserves the existing library error, including both supported profiles and the original code and UTF-8 byte offset. The lexer gate and successful Beta/Core1/Core2 routes are unchanged.

Validation retained three failing regression tests before the repair, then three passes after it. All 14 existing public source-check cases and the existing library header test also pass. The new tests compare complete JSON, quiet-human and normal-human outputs and exits against source-derived expectations frozen before execution. Rustfmt and diff checks pass. The committed tree matches all 887 recorded post-repair source pins.

This branch is based on #241. Fresh independent source/result review is pending. This is an ordinary diagnostic repair; it establishes no financial execution, compiler-Artifact, SDK, proof or ledger result. No hosted CI was dispatched.


Delivered to `main` by #252 (merge `370e4fa598dfaea05de9da5e2b15cd436161b450`). Both changed files are byte-identical to this PR’s candidate. This stacked delivery PR is superseded; its branch and evidence history are preserved. The separate financial/help/docs work and broader product acceptance remain open.
title: Preserve Core header diagnostics through public check
